spacing_review.note: Accepted. Read against the two joined pieces: the left piece ends with آله. and the right piece begins with کتبه; the full stop after و آله ends the first sentence and کتبه begins the signature line, so without the space two words would run together. Checked by code point: the inserted character is U+0020 at index 382 of 462; a character that is not a space stands on each side of it; the field has no doubled space; and the mapped pieces of the two sources lie directly before and after it, so the space is the only character added. The Persian field of the row comes whole from one source piece (r00015), so it has no junction and needs no space; it renders the whole joined Arabic.
